description: Requires techjobs.vn sign-in. Edits one entry of the signed-in user's Apply Tracker by its id: status, note and tracker details (source, CV used, salary, work mode, excitement, next step and its due date, outcome reason). Only the fields you pass change. Take the id from list_applications; to add a job or only move its status, track_job is simpler.

application_id.description: Apply Tracker entry id: the `id` of an entry from list_applications or track_job.

clear_fields.description: Details to remove from the entry, by name, e.g. ["salary_min", "excitement"].

cover_letter.description: Whether a cover letter was sent. Omit to keep the current value; to remove it, name it in clear_fields (text can also be cleared with an empty string).

cv_variant_id.description: Id of the CV (from list_my_cvs) sent with this application. Omit to keep the current value; to remove it, name it in clear_fields (text can also be cleared with an empty string).

excitement.description: How much the user wants the job, 1-5. Omit to keep the current value; to remove it, name it in clear_fields (text can also be cleared with an empty string).

location.description: Job location. Omit to keep the current value; to remove it, name it in clear_fields (text can also be cleared with an empty string).

next_action.description: The user's next step, e.g. "Follow up with the recruiter". Omit to keep the current value; to remove it, name it in clear_fields (text can also be cleared with an empty string).

next_action_at.description: ISO date or datetime the next step is due, e.g. 2026-10-12. Omit to keep the current value; to remove it, name it in clear_fields (text can also be cleared with an empty string).

note.description: The user's own note. Replaces the current note; omit to keep it, empty string to clear it.

outcome_note.description: Free text about the outcome. Omit to keep the current value; to remove it, name it in clear_fields (text can also be cleared with an empty string).

outcome_reason.description: Why the process ended (rejected, withdrawn, accepted…). Omit to keep the current value; to remove it, name it in clear_fields (text can also be cleared with an empty string).

recruiter_name.description: Recruiter or hiring contact. Omit to keep the current value; to remove it, name it in clear_fields (text can also be cleared with an empty string).

salary_currency.description: Currency of the salary. Omit to keep the current value; to remove it, name it in clear_fields (text can also be cleared with an empty string).

salary_max.description: Highest salary offered or expected. Omit to keep the current value; to remove it, name it in clear_fields (text can also be cleared with an empty string).

salary_min.description: Lowest salary offered or expected. Omit to keep the current value; to remove it, name it in clear_fields (text can also be cleared with an empty string).

salary_period.description: month or year. Omit to keep the current value; to remove it, name it in clear_fields (text can also be cleared with an empty string).

source_channel.description: Where the user found or applied to the job. Omit to keep the current value; to remove it, name it in clear_fields (text can also be cleared with an empty string).

status.description: Move the entry to this status. Omit to keep the current status.

work_mode.description: onsite, hybrid or remote. Omit to keep the current value; to remove it, name it in clear_fields (text can also be cleared with an empty string).

name: update_application
title: Update a tracked application
